title: Ramayana Advance Booking Crosses Rs 100 Crore Worldwide Ahead of Release
excerpt: Reported pre-sales of about Rs 105 crore, nearly 15 lakh tickets in India and $5 million overseas put Nitesh Tiwari's epic in select company two days before its November 5 opening.
body:
• Nitesh Tiwari's Ramayana has crossed Rs 100 crore in worldwide advance bookings, with reported pre-sales of about Rs 105 crore two days before its November 5 release.
  • India accounts for about Rs 58 crore of that total, including Rs 27 crore for opening day, and the film has sold nearly 15 lakh tickets across the country, according to Glamsham.
  • Overseas bookings reached $5 million by Tuesday morning, including more than $1.5 million from US paid previews scheduled for November 4.
  • On BookMyShow alone the film has passed 523,000 tickets, behind Jawan's 816,000 and Dhurandhar 2's 1.1 million advance sales on the platform, according to 123Telugu.

Nitesh Tiwari's Ramayana has crossed Rs 100 crore in worldwide advance bookings, two days before the Hindi-language epic opens in cinemas on November 5, 2026. Reported pre-sales stand at approximately Rs 105 crore worldwide, according to Glamsham, putting the film in a small group of Indian releases — including Baahubali 2, RRR, Pushpa 2 and Dhurandhar 2 — to have passed that mark before release. The milestone is a step up from the film's earlier benchmark, when advance booking crossed 2 lakh tickets in national chains for opening day.

Where the Rs 105 crore comes from

By November 3, the film had secured approximately Rs 58 crore in gross advance bookings in India, Glamsham reported. Of that, Rs 27 crore came from opening-day ticket sales, while the second and third days together contributed another Rs 25 crore. Nearly 15 lakh tickets have been sold across India. Premium formats have carried a disproportionate share: IMAX and other premium screens account for almost one-fourth of ticket sales despite representing only 4% of available screens, according to the report.

Bookings opened on Dussehra, October 15, roughly 15 days before release. Sales slowed after the initial rush because bookings were largely limited to the Hindi version and select screens, Glamsham reported. The pace changed last Friday after distributors and exhibitors resolved a revenue-sharing disagreement, and several single-screen theatres and smaller centres opened bookings.

The overseas and US picture

Overseas advance bookings reached $5 million by Tuesday morning, including more than $1.5 million from US paid previews, according to Glamsham. North America has emerged as an important contributor, with paid previews scheduled for November 4, a day before the worldwide release. For diaspora audiences, those preview numbers are the earliest hard signal of demand outside India.

The Dhurandhar 2 comparison

The platform race shows both the strength and the limit of the run so far. The film has clocked more than 523,000 tickets on BookMyShow, surpassing Animal, Tiger 3 and Chhaava on that measure, but it remains behind Jawan and Dhurandhar 2, according to 123Telugu. Matching Dhurandhar 2's 1.1 million ticket mark on the platform looks difficult in the remaining two days, the report said, though getting close to or surpassing Jawan's 816,000 advance sales is possible. Trade expectations cited by 123Telugu put the worldwide opening-day collection beyond Rs 150 crore — an expectation, not a result, that will be tested on November 5.

The film

Ramayana is a two-part film directed by Nitesh Tiwari and produced by Namit Malhotra's Prime Focus Studios in collaboration with DNEG and Yash's Monster Mind Creations. Ranbir Kapoor plays Lord Rama, Sai Pallavi plays Sita, Yash plays Ravana, Ravie Dubey plays Lakshman and Sunny Deol plays Lord Hanuman, with Kajal Aggarwal and Rakul Preet Singh also in key roles, according to the reports. Hans Zimmer and AR Rahman are composing the music, 123Telugu reported. The first part releases worldwide on November 5, 2026 in Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada and Malayalam. The second part is scheduled for Diwali 2027.
